{{Quote|I saw enough aboard your ship to believe we can risk using ''droids'' to send our gem out of the Golrath&hellip; ''and'' the galaxy!|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], to [[Domina Tagge/Legends|Domina Tagge]]|<ref name="SW50" />}}
The '''Golrath system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Sanbra sector/Legends|Sanbra sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Golrath/Legends|Golrath]].
